name: Remote servers
author: Majkelll
description: Keep a list of your own SSH servers in the bar: open a console, restart one, and watch live load/RAM/uptime per server. One button sets up key-based auth, so no password is ever stored or asked for again.

barWidget.description: Connect, restart, and watch load/RAM/uptime for the SSH servers you list.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often load/RAM is sampled over ssh while the popup is open. Not sampled at all while closed. Higher than a local plugin's default on purpose, since each sample is a network round trip rather than a local call.
